verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms RudderStack serves an llms.txt at rudderstack.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an LLM-oriented site summary. Its official MCP server also lets agents ask questions about RudderStack features and get AI-generated answers with source citations, a second agent-oriented docs channel. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the /docs/.md probe returned 404), evidence of llms.txt depth or coverage beyond its header, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
